remarks:
This Lake Front architectural home can be built with your finishing touches. Offering  the rare combination of privacy, acreage, and modern design—set on 3.60 acres with expansive water views. This thoughtfully designed 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home with a 2-car attached garage delivers an open-concept layout and the flexibility today’s buyers are looking for.

The main level features a bright, open floor plan with a spacious great room and a well-appointed kitchen complete with a large island, quartz countertops, and quality finishes throughout. The first-floor primary en-suite is perfectly positioned to take in lake views, offering both convenience and a true retreat feel. Step out onto the oversized deck—ideal for entertaining or simply enjoying the setting.

The walkout lower level adds exceptional living space with two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a generous entertainment area with a gas fireplace and kitchenette—perfect for guests, extended stays, or multi-generational use. Sliding doors lead to a covered patio, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living.

An additional 533 sq ft of unfinished space provides excellent storage or the opportunity to expand—ideal for a home office, fitness area, or additional living quarters.

Set on a private parcel with room to breathe, yet located just minutes from shops, restaurants, and local amenities, this property offers the best of both worlds—seclusion without sacrificing convenience.

A rare opportunity to own a lakefront spec home with space, views, versatility.
